content: We consider 80% of each dataset as training data to update the weights in the fine-tuning phase, 10% as validation data to measure the out-of-sample performance of the model during training, and 10% as test data to measure the out-of-sample performance after training. To prevent overfitting, we use stratified sampling to select 0.8, 0.1, and 0.1 portions of tweets from each class (racism/sexism/neither or hate/offensive/neither) for train, validation, and test. Classes' distribution of train, validation, and test datasets are shown in Table TABREF16.
